launch_command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh >/dev/null 2>&1; } && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && (test -d .venv || uv venv --system-site-packages --seed .venv) && . .venv/bin/activate && echo '[jl] Installing from' requirements.txt && uv pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 scripts/build_decision_data.py
